question: Can release/secops owners confirm that every caller performs artifact restoration before any candidate-controlled process can mutate the checkout?
rationale: The patch intentionally uses pathname validation under a documented trusted-harness lifecycle invariant rather than race-resistant filesystem handles, so only the workflow owners can confirm the security boundary.

options.title: Approve and refresh proof
options.body: Confirm the lifecycle invariant, integrate current main, and rerun the focused tests plus immutable installer smoke before merge.

options.title: Require stronger containment
options.body: If candidate mutation can overlap restoration, replace pathname validation with a race-resistant filesystem containment design.

recommendation.title: Approve and refresh proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the lifecycle invariant, integrate current main, and rerun the focused tests plus immutable installer smoke before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared restore lifecycle and is best positioned to verify its ordering across both installer-smoke callers.
